items.seed_concept: A linear chain of three masses: a learning bar at one end, a community commons at the other, and a civic hinge between them. The hinge gathers the school's public face (arrival, the office, the arts and the library) and acts as front door and crossroads, so every passage between learning and commons crosses it.
changes: administration moves from the civic hinge to the learning bar at chain end
custodial moves from floor 1 to floor 2 in the civic hinge

items.seed_name: Commons Heart Between Front and Learning
items.seed_concept: The commons is the central heart, with a civic front on one side and a learning wing on the other, each joined only through the heart. Arrival leads into the shared volume, and the learning wing lies beyond it, buffered from public entry. The arts move into the learning wing as part of daily teaching.
changes: custodial moves from the civic front to the learning wing beyond heart
the learning wing beyond heart and the central commons heart lose their direct link

items.seed_concept: A tall academy holds classrooms over the front office with the library at its crown. Beside it, a care-and-making house pairs specialized learning with the nurse and the arts. Together with the commons, the three masses close a loop around a shared court, each joined directly to the other two.
changes: custodial moves from the care-and-making house to the academy with library crown
